name: k08-feeding-india-van
prompt:
Late afternoon at a godown's loading bay in Hyderabad: a white van with its rear doors open; the food bank's city lead (a woman in her early thirties, a plain green T-shirt, a lanyard, hair in a bun) takes a plain kraft carton with a sage-green band from a godown worker in a grey T-shirt and smiles; a second worker brings another carton; her phone in her other hand. Medium shot, golden light, the two of them sharp.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. Every pack and carton is unbranded: plain kraft-brown cartons with a sage-green band, solid-colour snack packets (amber, green, red) with no lettering, Mango Drink as small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with no lettering. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no number plate anywhere. No children.
